notes: Production model: constant*tbabs*(zpowerlw + zgauss) in 0.5-10 keV. PN constant fixed to 1; MOS constants free. Fe K-alpha rest energy 6.4 keV, narrow-core sigma fixed to 50 eV. A free-width and a free-centroid fit are diagnostics; a blackbody soft-excess baseline is the continuum systematic check.
